say: Planning a meetup, but one friend isn't on WhatsApp?
Create an event, add a photo, and share one link with everyone.
Your friend opens it and can RSVP without downloading the app.
Replies land in the new Events Home, with reminders.
One limit: guests without WhatsApp see the address only after replying.
It's rolling out to everyone over the coming weeks.
Follow Media Diet for technology explained.
